role: assigned research engineer; rerun and reconciliation author, not independent reviewer
analysis_scope: Exactly four original 60-epoch main-grid fits rerun on current validated archives, CPU threads=2; replace only their effective reading records and recompute main aggregates, pairs and trends.

acceptance.scientific_provenance_scope: Current main-grid archive and manifest integrity PASS. A broader scientific PASS or independent-review verdict is not adjudicated by this assigned engineering task.

methods.precision: Arithmetic uses unrounded source values; JSON floats use Python repr binary64 round-trip precision. Markdown remains rounded to six decimals. Integer counts are exact; source SHA256s identify full-precision records.
methods.aggregate: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across four paired model/split seeds on dataset seed0.
methods.paired: d_s = metric_A(seed s) - metric_B(seed s); mean(d) +/- t(0.975,df=3)*sample_sd(d)/sqrt(4).
methods.sign_count: Strict positive / exact zero / strict negative unrounded differences.
methods.uncertainty: Seed/split variability only, conditional on one fixed generated cohort; no patient sampling interval, causal effect interval or multiplicity adjustment. Repeated cells within a run are not independent replicates.
methods.pooled_accuracy: Sum correct / sum denominators; reported separately from seed mean, especially for tolerance subsets with varying denominators.
methods.direction_primary: metrics.direction_accuracy.exact.post_effect: exact equality of adjacent-dose signs, with nonzero stored true difference.
methods.exact_zero: Exact true adjacent difference zero; empty subset is null (0/0), never accuracy zero or one.
methods.tolerance: Map absolute adjacent-dose differences <= channel tolerance to zero in BOTH prediction and truth; report all/post_effect/zero_effect separately.
methods.rmse: Per-channel physical-unit RMSE across patient x dose x scored time, 12600 values per channel per run. No unit-mixed macro average or legacy NRMSE comparison.

row_source_fields.status: Derived from finite, len(training_history)==config.epochs and final completion-log JSON; run.json has no native status field.

methods.group_sources: Each aggregate source_run_ids maps to main_rows/diagnostic_rows source.file and the row_source_fields above. Pair source_run_ids_a/b identify ordered A-B sources; denominators and correct counts retained.
methods.rerun_lineage: Logical main run IDs are retained for joins; source.file and source.sha256 identify the effective physical record. supersedes_source identifies each replaced historical record.
